> Wakil command **/wakil.billing-period** – Claude Code `/wakil.billing-period` · Cursor `/wakil-billing-period` · Codex `$wakil-billing-period`.
> Arguments: everything the user wrote after the command – expected: `<subscription> <start YYYY-MM-DD> [end YYYY-MM-DD] [amount] · show <subscription> · remove <subscription> <start>`.

# /wakil.billing-period – Subscription billing periods (SET_BILLING_PERIOD)

Act as the **manager** (`.claude/agents/manager/manager.md`). Arguments: the text the user wrote after the command

## Purpose
A subscription is paid for a period that rarely matches the calendar month (Claude Pro paid on the 15th covers
15 Nov → 14 Dec). Wakil Desktop and `/wakil.credits report` compute, **for every billing period**:

| Step | Formula | Example (20 $, 30-day period, 20 days elapsed, 4 000 credits) |
|---|---|---|
| cost of one day | period fee ÷ days in the period | 20 ÷ 30 = 0.667 $ |
| cost to date | cost of one day × days elapsed | 0.667 × 20 = 13.33 $ |
| cost of one credit | cost to date ÷ credits used in the period (all prompts of that subscription) | 13.33 ÷ 4 000 = 0.00333 $ |
| cost of an element | its credits × cost of one credit | a project with 1 200 credits = 4.00 $ |

Without a declared period, periods are derived from the subscription start date and its price frequency
(monthly → same day every month). Declare periods when the real dates or the amount paid differ.

## Arguments
| Argument | Required | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| subscription | yes | subscription id (`claude-pro`…) or name | – |
| start | yes (set) | first day of the paid period, `YYYY-MM-DD` | – |
| end | no | last day, `YYYY-MM-DD` | start + 1 frequency − 1 day (e.g. 15 Nov → 14 Dec) |
| amount | no | amount really paid for this period | the price in effect on `start` |
| action | no | `show` · `remove` | set |

## Preconditions
- The subscription exists (`/wakil.subscription show`). Node.js is available.

## Steps
1. Read the subscription, the start date, the optional end date and amount. Dates in words ("du 15 novembre au 14
   décembre") → `YYYY-MM-DD`. Missing start → ask (suggest the subscription's renewal day).
2. A custom **amount** (different from the configured price) is financially significant: restate it in one line
   ("Claude Pro 2026-11-15 → 2026-12-14: 20 USD – confirm?"), wait for "yes", then add `--yes`.
3. Run from the ecosystem root, with `--source-tool <claude|cursor|codex> --agent manager --command "<the owner's words>"`:
   - set: `node tools/ai-registry.cjs sub period <id> --start YYYY-MM-DD [--end YYYY-MM-DD] [--amount 20 --yes] [--currency USD]`
   - show: `node tools/ai-registry.cjs sub periods <id>`
   - remove: `node tools/ai-registry.cjs sub period <id> --remove YYYY-MM-DD --yes` (confirm first)
4. Report the `✓` line (dates, days, cost of one day). Then, if the owner wants the figures now:
   `node tools/credit-log.cjs report --subscription <id> --by project`.

## Rules
- Only `tools/ai-registry.cjs` writes `usage/registry.json`; never hand-edit it.
- Periods of one subscription never overlap (the tool refuses; remove the old one first).
- Never invent an amount: use the configured price or the figure the owner gives.

## Output
The period (start → end, days, amount, cost per day), or the list of declared periods.

## Schedulable
`show` only.

## Examples
- `/wakil.billing-period claude-pro 2026-11-15`
- `/wakil.billing-period cursor-pro du 3 novembre au 2 décembre 2026, payé 20 $`
- `/wakil.billing-period claude-pro 2026-12-15 2027-01-14 25`
- `/wakil.billing-period show claude-pro`
- `/wakil.billing-period remove claude-pro 2026-11-15`
